en: A black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view labeled "Arco" at the top. In the background, a dramatic rocky hill rises with a fortified castle or ruins on its summit, surrounded by trees. In the foreground there is a low stone wall, a narrow water channel, cultivated fields or vineyards, and a few houses and trees lining a path where long white cloths appear to be laid out to dry. The scene is framed by distant mountains under a lightly clouded sky. Printer information and a serial number appear at the bottom left.
